text: Vaccines undergo rigorous multi-phase clinical trials before approval and are continuously monitored for safety after release.
Global average temperatures have risen approximately 1.1 degrees Celsius since the pre-industrial era, based on long-term satellite and ground station data.
Electronic voting machines used in national elections undergo certification, mock polls, and physical audits before and after voting.
5G network signals operate at frequencies that do not have enough energy to damage DNA or cause biological harm.
Claims that spread rapidly on social media without a named, verifiable source should be treated as unverified until confirmed by independent reporting.
